Description

About Alvarez & Marsal

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action- and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and helping them reach their potential. A&M is different by design: we give people ownership and impact from day one, fuel development through real opportunity, and provide direct access to leaders who invest in our growth. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact clients and shape our industry. Guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, our collaborative, globally minded environment is why our people love working at A&M.

The Team

A&M’s Performance Canada, With Offices In Toronto And Montreal, Partners With Corporate And Private Equity Clients To Drive Sustainable Improvements In Operational Performance And Maximize Value From Transactions. Our Professionals Are Aligned By Service Line, Enabling Deep Functional Expertise And Tailored Solutions That Address Each Client’s Unique Business Challenges. Our Core Service Offerings Include

Performance Improvement
Operational Due Diligence
Merger Integration & Carve-outs

Performance Canada is a growing service line with ambitious targets over the next 2–4 years. We offer outstanding opportunities for career progression and leadership development. Our leadership team is committed to supporting your professional journey through structured development programs, comprehensive training, and opportunities for international business exposure.

Join the Performance Improvement team at A&M Performance Canada and develop a broad, high-impact set of operational skills. You'll gain early exposure to high-profile clients and work alongside leading professionals in the field. From strategic design to hands-on implementation, you'll contribute to large, complex engagements primarily across North America, with opportunities to support global projects.

A&M’s Performance Improvement services take a holistic, cross-functional approach that rapidly identifies high-impact opportunities, improving financial performance and enhancing processes across all functions. Our work includes top-line growth strategy, operational streamlining, organizational optimization, and cost reduction, all supported by advanced technology, digital solutions, and artificial intelligence tools.

As you help corporate clients and private equity portfolio companies navigate transformation and achieve superior performance, you will gain valuable insight into how businesses evolve and succeed. You will also broaden your experience across industries and enjoy extensive opportunities to grow your career as part of a dynamic and fast-paced team.

How You Will Contribute

Translate complex data into actionable insights that uncover performance gaps and improvement opportunities.
Identify and quantify cost transformation initiatives by optimizing organizational structures, staffing models, and operational processes.
Develop and deliver strategic recommendations that align with business objectives and drive sustainable results.
Contribute to the creation of implementation roadmaps, operating models, and business cases.
Partner with clients to prioritize initiatives and lead end-to-end implementation of performance improvement programs.
Conduct site visits, management interviews, and document reviews to validate operational assumptions and evaluate organizational capabilities.
Perform industry research and benchmarking and gather financial and operational KPIs to incorporate external insights and challenge internal performance assumptions.
Leverage deep experience in areas such as margin management, pricing strategy, product rationalization, sales and operations planning, sourcing and global supply chain optimization, organizational effectiveness, non-labor cost efficiency, process improvement, SG&A cost reduction, and working capital management.
Manage multiple workstreams and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Provide hands-on leadership and guidance to delivery teams, ensuring high-quality execution and client satisfaction.
Contribute to business development efforts, including proposal development and client pitches.
Support talent development through coaching, staffing input, and mentorship.
Participate in recruitment and retention initiatives.

Qualifications

12+ years of professional experience in industry and/or consulting, with a strong focus on cost optimization, operational restructuring, turnarounds, or operational improvement.
Deep expertise in at least one functional area, such as:
Pricing, margin, and mix optimization
Salesforce effectiveness
Marketing efficiency
Operations management and productivity
Supply chain and procurement
SG&A cost reduction
Organization optimization
Finance and Accounting Operations
Leadership engagement and stakeholder alignment

Industry depth in sectors such as manufacturing, business services, consumer products, retail, quick-service restaurants, talent services, or environmental services is a strong plus.
Experience working with private equity firms or portfolio companies is highly valued.
Background in both professional services and corporate roles is a plus.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, business, finance, or a related field; MBA preferred.
High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; strong analytical and presentation skills.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.
Strong project management skills with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.
Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively in fast-paced environments.
Flexibility to travel at least 50% of time, primarily across Canada and the U.S., with potential for global assignments.

Your journey at A&M

At A&M, professional growth is tied directly to performance, not tenure. Our people take on meaningful, hands-on work supported by a performance development process that rewards contribution and fosters a culture of meritocracy. Stretch roles, evolving business needs, and firm growth create ongoing opportunities for ownership and building new skills, while direct access to senior leaders provides mentorship and real-time coaching along the way. We also prioritize your wellbeing through comprehensive benefits and resources. Together, these elements create an environment where high-performing professionals can continue to grow and advance from day one.

A&M is committed to providing an accessible recruitment process that meets our obligations under the Ontario Human Rights Code, the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 and any other applicable legislation. We strive to maintain a strong and dynamic workforce that fosters respect and inclusivity for applicants of all abilities. Should you have any accessibility need(s) and/or require accommodation during the recruitment process, please notify Human Resources at HR@alvarezandmarsal.com and we would be pleased to assist you.

The salary range is around $135,000 CAD annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

jobs.description:
Directeur(trice) principal, Solutions aux patients, Canada

À titre de Directeur(trice) principal, Solutions aux patients
, le titulaire est principalement responsable de mettre en place, développer et diriger
l’unité d’affaires Solutions aux patients d’Inizio Engage au Canada.

Le titulaire sera également responsable du développement des affaires et de la croissance des capacités actuelles en Solutions aux patients
, ainsi que de l’expansion vers d’autres services de HUB de Solutions aux patients sur le marché canadien. Il devra assurer l’excellence opérationnelle de l’ensemble des projets de l’unité d’affaires Solutions aux patients au Canada, en mettant particulièrement l’accent sur :

l’élaboration de la stratégie des solutions aux patients;
l’infrastructure opérationnelle;
la gouvernance clinique;
les besoins de formation axés sur les compétences liées au poste;
les solutions cliniques.

Le titulaire assurera le développement, l’expansion et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie globale d’Inizio Engage et de Solutions aux patients au Canada, tout en veillant au respect des exigences réglementaires, de conformité et de compétence professionnelle. Le poste relève du Directeur général, Canada

Subordonnés directs :

Directeur, Opérations, Solutions aux patients
Responsable des infirmières cliniciennes éducatrices (ICE)

Lieu de travail :

Le titulaire du poste peut être basé à Montréal ou travailler à distance, avec l’obligation de se présenter au siège social de Montréal lorsque requis, ainsi qu’aux bureaux des clients et à différents lieux de réunion au Canada à l’occasion. Le titulaire devra se conformer à la politique de travail hybride de l’entreprise.

Leadership et définition de l’orientation stratégique

Élaborer une vision stratégique permettant de développer, faire croître et diriger l’unité d’affaires Solutions aux patients d’Inizio Engage Canada, en intégrant les services HUB actuels et futurs.
Développer et mettre en œuvre la stratégie des services Solutions aux patients d’Inizio Engage Canada en cohérence avec le Centre mondial d’excellence.
En étroite collaboration avec le responsable international des Solutions aux patients, accroître les capacités et l’envergure des services Solutions aux patients au Canada, notamment par le développement de nouvelles offres de services, de modèles flexibles et l’identification d’occasions d’affaires permettant la croissance de l’unité d’affaires.
Maintenir une connaissance approfondie des besoins des clients et des activités des concurrents afin de positionner Inizio Engage en tête du marché et favoriser sa croissance.
Agir comme ambassadeur et promoteur du développement des services numériques et de l’intelligence artificielle dans l’ensemble des programmes Solutions aux patients. Veiller à ce que ces services soient développés, tarifés et positionnés de façon à maximiser leur potentiel.
S’assurer que les activités de Solutions aux patients d’Inizio Engage Canada respectent les exigences des organismes de réglementation et les codes de conduite applicables.
Participer activement à l’élaboration de la stratégie internationale de Solutions aux patients au sein du Centre d’excellence.

Gestion financière

Assumer la responsabilité de l’établissement et de l’atteinte des objectifs financiers, y compris les budgets, prévisions et états des résultats (P&L) de Solutions aux patients au Canada.
Mettre en œuvre des plans visant l’amélioration et la croissance des marges bénéficiaires.
Participer au processus mensuel de prévisions financières locales et fournir des données exactes et pertinentes.

Développement des affaires

Être le principal point de contact pour toutes les activités de développement des affaires et identifier de nouvelles occasions visant à accroître l’offre actuelle de Solutions aux patients d’Inizio Engage au Canada.
Développer de nouveaux services HUB en Solutions aux patients intégrant des approches novatrices aux modèles intégrés actuellement offerts.
Assurer le suivi de toutes les occasions d’affaires en Solutions aux patients provenant des membres de l’équipe de développement des affaires ou d’autres secteurs de l’organisation.
Maintenir un portefeuille d’opportunités commerciales solide et durable.
Collaborer avec les collègues du développement des affaires au Canada afin d’élaborer et de mettre en œuvre le plan de développement des affaires de Solutions aux patients, conformément à la stratégie établie, et identifier les aires thérapeutiques cibles ainsi que les offres de services associées pouvant être développées localement.
Participer aux présentations commerciales au niveau local et, au besoin, au niveau international; participer également aux rencontres avec les clients, aux réunions de gestion de comptes et à toute autre rencontre nécessaire au maintien et au développement des relations clients.
Veiller à ce que les réponses aux appels d’offres (RFP) et autres demandes soient préparées selon les plus hauts standards de qualité, à partir du matériel et des données approuvés les plus récents, et soumises dans les délais prescrits.
Collaborer avec le Centre mondial d’excellence, particulièrement avec le responsable international des Solutions aux patients, afin de faire progresser le programme international de développement des affaires et d’identifier des aires thérapeutiques et des offres de services pouvant être déployées sur plusieurs marchés.

Gestion opérationnelle

S’assurer que des plans solides de gestion des talents, d’évaluation du rendement et de développement professionnel sont en place pour tous les employés relevant directement du poste. Une composante essentielle du rôle consiste à mettre en œuvre un plan de relève robuste et à assurer le développement continu des compétences de l’équipe.
Veiller à maintenir des effectifs appropriés et efficients, ainsi qu’à définir la structure organisationnelle du département en fonction de l’évolution des besoins et des priorités futures.
Incarner et promouvoir les valeurs d’Inizio Engage.

Exigences Et Qualifications

Au moins 5 années d’expérience dans un poste de direction supérieur comportant la responsabilité du développement et de la prestation de programmes de solutions ou de soutien aux patients.
Diplôme universitaire requis, ou titre d’infirmière autorisée (IA), ou infirmière praticienne (IP).
Une expérience en ventes, développement des affaires ou marketing dans l’industrie pharmaceutique, biotechnologique ou des services de santé est essentielle.
Une excellente connaissance du système de santé canadien et des mécanismes de remboursement est requise.
Expérience en gestion de projets et de processus, ainsi qu’une connaissance générale des politiques et processus opérationnels.
Solide sens des affaires et des finances, avec une expérience en gestion budgétaire et en gestion des états des résultats (P&L) d’un département ou d’une unité d’affaires.
Penseur stratégique doté d’une forte capacité d’influence et d’un historique démontré de développement et de mise en œuvre réussis de stratégies organisationnelles ou de services.
Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de leadership.

Compétences clés requises

Développe les capacités et les talents

Valeur: Nous donnons à chacun les moyens d’agir

Attire et sélectionne des talents diversifiés et hautement qualifiés.
Accorde une grande importance à son propre développement ainsi qu’à celui des autres.
Agit comme coach et mentor auprès de ses collègues.
Partage de façon proactive l’information, les connaissances et son expertise.

Fait preuve d’imputabilité

Valeur: Nous faisons ce qu’il faut

Établit des normes de rendement élevées avec des objectifs clairs.
Se tient lui-même et tient les autres responsables de leurs décisions, actions, réussites et échecs.
Assume pleinement la responsabilité de la qualité des résultats livrés.
Possède un historique démontré d’atteinte des objectifs.

Leadership des personnes et de l’organisation

Valeur: Nous travaillons ensemble

Communique une vision claire et mobilisatrice qui inspire les équipes et les relie à l’organisation.
Écoute activement les autres et favorise l’expression ouverte d’idées et de points de vue diversifiés.
Communique avec clarté et impact à tous les niveaux de l’organisation.
Établit et respecte des normes de comportement appropriées.
Exerce son leadership de façon équitable et cohérente.

Leadership des affaires et des finances

Valeur: Nous relevons les défis

Se tient informé des politiques, pratiques et tendances actuelles et futures de l’organisation, du marché et de la concurrence.
Utilise son sens stratégique et sa compréhension des moteurs d’affaires pour guider ses décisions.
Utilise efficacement les données pour soutenir la prise de décision.
Démontre une solide compréhension de la performance financière de l’entreprise, de ses indicateurs et de leurs implications.
Contrôle les coûts et raisonne en termes de profits, pertes et valeur ajoutée.

Orientation client

Valeur: Nous travaillons ensemble

Cerne les besoins actuels et futurs des clients et développe de solides relations pour offrir des solutions axées sur le client.
Établit et maintient de véritables partenariats avec les clients internes et externes en dépassant les attentes et en offrant un service d’excellence.
Fait preuve de proactivité, de flexibilité et d’agilité face aux besoins des clients.

Bâtit des équipes performantes

Valeur: Nous donnons à chacun les moyens d’agir

Crée un environnement inclusif où chacun est motivé à donner le meilleur de lui-même et se sent valorisé.
Constitue des équipes performantes grâce à une combinaison diversifiée de styles, perspectives et expériences.
Favorise le dialogue ouvert, la collaboration et la rétroaction constructive.
Gère les conflits et les conversations difficiles de manière constructive
Reconnaît et récompense les contributions des membres de l’équipe.
Encourage la collaboration et le réseautage à travers l’organisation.

Innove

Valeur: Nous nous demandons ce qui se passerait si

Anticipe avec justesse les tendances futures et leurs répercussions.
Favorise l’innovation afin de trouver des solutions nouvelles et créatives.
Évolue aisément dans l’ambiguïté et la complexité.
Pose les bonnes questions afin d’analyser efficacement les situations.
Introduit des approches créatives de résolution de problèmes.
Encourage la diversité des idées afin de stimuler l’innovation.
S’adapte efficacement aux différentes situations et gère la complexité avec aisance.

Orienté vers l’action

Valeur: Nous faisons ce qu’il faut

Agit avec urgence et énergie dans tout ce qu’il entreprend.
Favorise le changement et l’amélioration continue.
Fait preuve de résilience et soutient les autres dans les situations difficiles.
Cherche continuellement à atteindre les plus hauts standards d’excellence.

Nos Avantages:

Prestations de santé dès le premier jour d’emploi
Primes d’ancienneté
Prix étoile trimestriel
Récompenses annuelles du cercle d’excellence Inizio
Prime pour recommendation
Bibliothèque de cours de formation en ligne

Échelle salariale: $170K-$185K plus boni

À propos d’Inizio Engage :   

Inizio Engage est un partenaire d’affaires responsable, stratégique et créatif spécialisé dans les soins de santé. Notre main-d’œuvre mondiale passionnée renforce l’expertise locale et les diverses compétences avec les données, la science et la technologie pour fournir des solutions d’implication sur mesure qui aident les clients à repenser leur façon d’interagir avec leurs patients, les payeurs, les individus et les fournisseurs afin d’améliorer les résultats des traitements. Notre mission est de travailler en partenariat avec nos clients, d’améliorer des vies en aidant les professionnels de soins de santé et les patients à obtenir les médicaments, les connaissances et le soutien dont ils ont besoin.   

Nous croyons en nos valeurs : Nous donnons à chacun les moyens d’agir, nous relevons les défis, nous travaillons ensemble, nous nous demandons

jobs.title: National Vice President, Electrical
jobs.description:
The National Vice President of Electrical owns the commercial success, strategic growth, and financial performance of the Electrical division across Ontario and potential expansion markets. This leader is accountable for P&L performance, revenue growth, market positioning, and enterprise integration.

Why This Role Matters to Modern Niagara

The National Vice President of Electrical is key to Modern Niagara’s ability to grow its Electrical business profitably, strengthen client relationships, and expand into new markets. By aligning Electrical with Mechanical and Construction teams, this leader helps deliver integrated solutions that meet clients’ needs and create opportunities across the business. This role also builds the leadership and operational capacity needed to support long-term growth while maintaining a safety-first culture.

Key Impact / Purpose

Drive profitable growth of the Electrical division through strategic market expansion, strong client relationships, and disciplined financial leadership.
Strengthen Modern Niagara’s integrated offering by aligning Electrical, Mechanical, and Construction teams to pursue and deliver client solutions.
Build the leadership, talent, and operational capacity needed to sustain long-term growth while championing a safety-first culture.

D
uties and Responsibilities:

Strategic Growth & Market Expansion

Develop and execute a 3–5 year Electrical growth strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
Identify priority verticals.
Lead geographic expansion nationally.
Evaluate partnerships, joint ventures, and acquisition opportunities.

Business Development & Client Leadership

Own revenue growth targets and pipeline development.
Develop C-suite and senior client relationships with developers, GCs, municipalities, and institutional clients.
Lead major pursuits and positioning strategies for complex projects.
Collaborate inter-departmentally to drive integrated design-build opportunities.
Increase cross-selling across service lines.

P&L and Financial Leadership

Full P&L ownership for the Electrical division.
Drive margin performance and cost discipline.
Oversee forecasting, backlog management, and pricing strategy.
Improve bid-to-win ratios and ensure disciplined project selection.
Lead financial reviews with executive leadership.

Organizational Leadership

Provide direction and performance oversight to the Senior Leaders
Scale the Electrical division (talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership bench).
Align operational capacity with growth strategy.
Champion a high-performance, safety-first culture.

Enterprise Alignment

Participate in corporate strategic planning.
Support capital planning and resource allocation decisions.
Ensure integrated execution with Mechanical and Construction teams.

Must haves:

12+ years in electrical contracting, engineering, or construction.
5–10 years in senior leadership with P&L accountability.
Proven track record growing revenue in the construction market.
Strong relationships within ICI
Financial fluency (WIP reporting, margin analysis, forecasting).
Eng. or trade background.

Competitive Total Compensation Package, Commensurate With Experience

Modern Niagara offers a competitive total compensation package including: 

Defined Contribution Pension Plan with a generous employer contribution 
Flexible Health and Dental benefits with tiered options to meet the needs of you and your family 
An annual health spending account to support your overall wellness 
24/7 confidential support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program with access to comprehensive resources and professional services 
A competitive vacation package with additional vacation granted throughout your tenure with the organization. 
Employer Paid Parental Leave Top Up 
Annual Community Day dedicated to volunteering and giving back to the communities where we live and work 
Corporate Discounts through various vendors across Canada for programs such as fitness, mobile phones, travel, home and auto insurance and many others 

Here at Modern Niagara, because we know our people are the best in the industry, we pride ourselves on providing a total compensation package that rewards employees for their hard work and supports employees and their families in their overall wellbeing.  

About Modern Niagara

Who We Are

Modern Niagara helps building owners, managers, and general contractors meet the mechanical, and electrical needs of their buildings across Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, Toronto, Southwestern Ontario, and Ottawa. We are committed to having a positive and meaningful impact on Canada’s infrastructure — and on the communities where we live, learn, work, and heal. We build for life.

Our Culture & Values

We value passion, initiative, determination, professionalism, and teamwork. Health and safety are embedded in everything we do, and our award-winning safety culture consistently performs well above industry standards.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Modern Niagara

We are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization where everyone has access to opportunity, feels a sense of belonging, and can thrive. We actively work to remove barriers faced by members of equity-seeking groups (including women, Indigenous, Black, racialized, 2SLGBTQIA+ people, people with disabilities, and newcomers to Canada) in the construction industry. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and lived experiences and are committed to a barrier-free hiring process. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us at careers@modernniagara.com so we can make appropriate arrangements.

We appreciate every applicant’s interest in joining Modern Niagara. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director, Project Controls Nuclear
jobs.description:
About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Purpose

Worley is seeking a Director, Project Controls Nuclear in Toronto, Ontario. The Nuclear Project Controls Director is responsible for leading the project controls function across a portfolio of nuclear projects, ensuring the effective implementation of cost management, planning and scheduling, progress measurement, forecasting, reporting, risk management, and change management processes. This role provides leadership, mentorship, and technical oversight to project controls teams while partnering closely with project managers, engineering leaders, construction teams, clients, and senior stakeholders to enable successful project delivery.

The successful candidate will champion project controls best practices, drive consistency and governance, and ensure accurate, timely, and insightful reporting that supports project performance and strategic decision-making.

You Will Be Part Of a Growing Team That Is Embedded In The Transformation Of Ontario’s Nuclear Fleet, Working On Critical Projects, Some Of The Most Ambitious Clean Energy Programs In The World. Why Join Worley’s Nuclear Team

The scale of impact — supporting cornerstone projects that power millions of homes with zero-emissions energy.
The engineering culture — technically rigorous, quality-driven, and execution-focused.
The people — high-performing, collaborative teams who care deeply about what they do.
The opportunity to grow — not just personally, but to help shape the next generation of nuclear professionals.

If you’re looking for more than a job — if you want to help build the future of energy — we’re hiring across all disciplines. Come work where it matters.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Functional Excellence

Lead and develop a high-performing team of project controls professionals across a portfolio of nuclear projects.
Establish project controls governance, standards, processes, and reporting frameworks aligned with Worley systems and procedures.
Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Provide mentoring, coaching, and career development support to project controls personnel.
Support recruitment, workforce planning, succession planning, and capability development initiatives within the project controls function.

Job Description

Senior Director, Purchasing and Estimating

Toronto, Ontario

Build What's Next At Minto

Working at Minto means being part of something bigger – where your career is built on purpose, progress, and possibility. Here, employees aren’t just valued – they’re celebrated through peer-to-peer recognition, team events, and a culture that feels like family while honouring every individual’s voice.

From day one, we've got you covered

From Your Very First Day At Minto, You'll Have Access To a Rewarding And Supportive Package Designed To Help You Thrive

Competitive compensation with performance-based annual bonus
A peer-to-peer recognition platform that celebrates your contributions
Professional development and learning support to fuel your growth
Exciting career paths across a dynamic and purpose-driven organization

Your place in our story

Lead the Purchasing and Estimating functions across all residential product types
Develops reliable conceptual and detailed construction budgets to support feasibility, pro formas, and project approvals
Establish procurement and tendering strategies that maximize purchasing leverage and competitiveness across the organization
Leverage NewStar ERP system to facilitate tendering process, contract pricing management, and procurement activities
Lead major trade and supplier negotiations and provide oversight of contract awards, and the execution of contracts in a timely manner
Partner with the Design Centre to tender, negotiate, and establish competitive pricing for purchaser upgrades, options, finishes, and other Minto offerings
Ensure upgrade pricing reflects current material and labour costs and appropriate margins in coordination with the Design Centre, while supporting a strong customer experience
Monitor GTA construction costs, escalation, labour availability, supply-chain conditions, and trade capacity
Partner with Development and Construction throughout pre-construction to identify cost risks and maintain alignment with approved budgets
Collaborate with Construction to review, develop, and amend scopes of work as required to improve quality control and accuracy of stated work
Lead value-engineering initiatives to improve project economics while protecting quality and customer experience
Establish cost benchmarks and reporting for estimate accuracy, committed costs, forecast costs, variances, and cost-to-complete
Develop strategic relationships with key subcontractors, suppliers, and industry partners
Lead, develop, and mentor the Purchasing and Estimating team and establish consistent processes and accountabilities across the function

Here’s How You’ll Contribute

The Senior Director, Purchasing & Estimating provides strategic leadership for purchasing, estimating, and construction cost management across a portfolio of low-rise and high-rise residential developments.

This role is responsible for driving cost certainty, procurement effectiveness, and value throughout the development lifecycle, from early feasibility and project budgeting through design, tendering, construction, and warranty. The Senior Director, Purchasing & Estimating works closely with multiple internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure Minto’s projects achieve financial, quality, and schedule goals while delivering homes and communities that meet or exceed our customers’ expectations.

What You Bring To The Team

Here’s what will help you stand out. And even if you don’t tick every box, we believe in your potential and are here to support your growth

Education: 

Degree or diploma in Architectural, Construction Technologist, Civil Engineering or Construction, or a related discipline preferred

Experience: 

10+ years of progressive experience in residential construction, estimating, purchasing, or pre-construction, including significant leadership experience.
Strong experience with a residential builder/developer in the GTA, ideally spanning low, and high-rise construction.
Knowledge of NewStar ERP system.
Proven expertise in construction estimating, tendering, procurement, contract negotiation, cost planning, and value engineering.
Strong knowledge of the GTA trades and suppliers
Excellent negotiation, analytical, and leadership capabilities
Strong negotiator and relationship builder
Highly analytical with a focus on cost certainty
Collaborative and influential across functions
Able to balance cost, quality, schedule, and risk
Proven ability to build and develop high-performing teams

Ready to build your future with us?

Whether you're just starting out or looking to take the next step, Minto offers the mentorship, resources, and opportunities to grow a meaningful career. With competitive rewards and a strong commitment to well-being, we empower you to thrive professionally and personally.

Join a team where your growth, purpose, and potential are celebrated. Let’s create something meaningful.
